verifiedRecords.quality: κ+o(κ) colors asymptotically; κ+1 in the small-input central branch
verifiedRecords.displayBound: O(1) rounds; n processors × O(n log²n) bits
verifiedRecords.totalMemory: O(n²log²n) bits allocated across n processors (direct product)
verifiedRecords.localWork: The gathered subgraphs are colored locally; the model allows arbitrary local work.
verifiedRecords.theorem: ICALP Theorem 12; full version Theorem 4.3 and proof
assumptions: κ is graph degeneracy and is not assumed known; geometric guesses are used.
The proof centrally handles m=O(n log n), giving κ+1 colors.
For the remaining case κ=ω(log n), its asymptotic palette is κ+o(κ).
The theorem allocates n processors, each with O(n log²n) bits.
verifiedRecords.notes: κ≤Δ, but κ+o(κ) is not a numerical substitute for Δ+1. Do not read the little-o notation as exact κ colors for fixed κ. The κ=ω(log²n) restriction belongs to the separate Congested Clique theorem, not this MPC theorem.
